groups.decision: Retain cloud/entitlement and enabled-unlicensed-member scope. Relocated basename/title is not source-publication equivalence; referenced access/concept content remains separate.
UI/REST requests and typical latency are not completed review, defect absence or approval. Manual and automatic-review setup are separate effective states.
Changed-head review and approval dismissal differ from comment resolution. Require exact-head evidence and re-review configuration; suppressed/repeated comments do not prove remediation.

Default Comment and overview assessment do not satisfy merge rules. Preview approving-review behavior requires explicit enablement, inherited policy and path applicability; no native human-approval substitution is presumed.
Applying suggestions or using Fix with Copilot can mutate code or create a separate PR. Follow-up human comments are not model-visible discussion. Maintain reviewed plan/diff and exact target intent.
Lite and Balanced are differing review strategies, not assurance levels. Per-review, personal and authorized automatic defaults must be distinguished.

Repository-wide/path-specific/multiple instruction sources and head-branch origin must be recorded. A malicious or edited PR can change review guidance. Never treat instruction-file existence as native enforcement or imported examples as executor authority.

Configured/default MCP and relevant skills are not proven use. Reviewer MCP enablement is separate from cloud-agent enablement. Require comment attributions/session logs and scoped tool/credential access.

Ephemeral environment is not sandbox proof. Dedicated review workflow overrides shared setup; reviewer firewall settings are distinct from cloud-agent firewall and need separate effective verification.
Feedback improvement wording is not a data-training/retention agreement. SVG/editorial context does not carry an independently reviewed image grant or operational control.
Highlighted selection and uncommitted-change reviews have distinct coverage. Applied suggestions are not automatically committed, and UI comments are not merge approvals.
Visual Studio17.14 prerequisite is surface-specific. No-comment output and dismissed UI comments do not certify clean code; linked vendor setup is separate evidence.
Mobile request workflow triggers PR review rather than an independently verified local editing/approval capability.
Xcode extension0.41 prerequisite, staged/unstaged selection and deselected files bound coverage. Accept/Dismiss actions are code decisions, not correctness assurance.
Verify listed IDE identity, installed plugin and sign-in separately; a compatibility-list entry or dismissed comment is not actual review/enforcement.
Authenticated GitHub CLI reviewer requests are distinct from Copilot CLI session tooling; explicit PR/branch target context is required and examples are inert.

profiles.solo: Own PR/change context, plan/entitlement and deliberate bot-review request; human review policy remains independently adopted.
profiles.organization: Member licensing exceptions, organization enablement, inherited enterprise policies, repository rulesets/path applicability and authorized owners.
profiles.enterprise: Preserve enterprise override/delegation rules and cross-organization effective seat/billing/permission scope; no universal restrictive merge rule.

dimensions: source pin versus acquired published body
exact PR/head SHA and changed-head re-review
review event type versus overview approval assessment
preview approvals enabled and applicable file-path rules
reviewer-specific MCP/tool/credential configuration and actual use
dedicated versus shared setup workflow precedence
comment severity/effort versus independently verified defects
cost-bearing Actions/agent execution and actual approval
generalized_review_model.unknown: Missing authorization, entitlement, effective policy, matching head, event type, target coverage, context use or environment restrictions is UNVERIFIED, not PASS.

proposed_behavior_checks.required: A default Comment/overview assessment does not increment required approving-review count.
Explicitly enabled approving review counts only for the configured target/file scope; other paths remain unmet.
A new commit dismisses the approving review and only a matching-head review satisfies the configured rule.
Log the head-branch instruction/skill digest and verify unexpected changes are not mistaken for trusted base policy.
Disable reviewer MCP only under approved plan; observe no reviewer tool calls while preserving separately configured cloud-agent behavior.
Verify reviewer network permissions independently of cloud-agent firewall, including denied destinations.
Inspect effective setup identity when dedicated review workflow and shared setup both exist, without executing untrusted imported examples.
Restore approved review configuration and validate prior functionality and exact-head rule behavior after negative tests.

remaining_work: Integrate code-review concept/configuration, cost and limits claims
Independent full-source claim fidelity/omission and mapping audit
Canonical control/profile/template applicability and policy acceptance review
Explicit scoped target approval, native positive/negative and recovery receipts
